summary: Mr. Harari discusses customs related to parshiot, including a correction for Parshat Beresheet regarding the custom of saying beresiman tovah before reading. He also addresses variations in stopping points for Parshat Noah and reviews the proper makam for Parshat Vayera.
questions: What custom do we have when the first ole goes up to Sefer Beresheet?
Where do different communities stop for Parshat Noah?
What is the proper makam for Parshat Vayera?
Why is Makam Nahawand important for Kabalat Shabbat?
